Description: SWE-bench Verified evaluates autonomous software-engineering patch generation on a curated set of real GitHub issues that have been human-verified as solvable and correctly testable. A model must understand the bug/feature request, modify repository code, and pass the provided tests under a standardized harness.
Cognitive Functions:
L1: Language Comprehension (minor)
L2: Planning, Logical Reasoning, Working Memory, Adaptive Error Correction (minor)
L3: Inhibitory Control (minor)

Description: SWE-bench Multilingual extends SWE-bench-style repository patching beyond Python to multiple programming languages, aiming to evaluate whether agentic coding generalizes across language ecosystems and toolchains. Success requires producing a correct patch that satisfies tests and repository conventions in each language setting.
Cognitive Functions:
L1: Language Comprehension (minor)
L2: Planning, Logical Reasoning, Working Memory
L3: Cognitive Flexibility
